Class HasExpRequirement

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.requirement.impl.AbstractRequirement
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.requirement.impl.requirements.HasExpRequirement
All Implemented Interfaces:
Requirement
public class HasExpRequirement extends AbstractRequirement
Checks whether a player has at least a specified amount of experience points.

YAML:

type: has_exp
amount: 500
